vignette: A 25-year-old woman has a slow, coarse tremor of the right arm that is present at rest, worsens when she holds the arm out and becomes wild when she reaches for a cup. It began three months after a midbrain hemorrhage.

options.text: Left dentatorubrothalamic tract with the nigrostriatal fibers in the midbrain

explanation: A delayed rest-postural-intention tremor after a midbrain lesion is Holmes (rubral) tremor, from combined damage to the cerebellothalamic fibers passing through the red nucleus and to the nigrostriatal fibers; the lesion is contralateral (left midbrain) because the dentatorubrothalamic tract has already crossed.
